beats.narration: New books preserve 144 names after a village lost its future in seconds.
beats.relevanceExplanation: Illustrative graphic for beat 1: "New books preserve 144 names after a village lost its future in seconds."

beats.narration: On 21 October 1966, a coal waste tip collapsed onto Aberfan.
beats.relevanceExplanation: Illustrative graphic for beat 2: "On 21 October 1966, a coal waste tip collapsed onto Aberfan."

beats.narration: 144 people lost their lives, including 116 children.

beats.narration: The National Library of Wales finished new copies of the Books of Remembrance ahead of July 2026.
